NEXT Canada Entrepreneur Portal Apply to NEXT AI Saved Apply to NEXT AI English Français Deadline 📆 December 9th, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. EST Thank you for applying to NEXT AI, one of NEXT Canada’s three programs and Canada’s premier accelerator for entrepreneurs building AI-enabled companies that address global challenges. NEXT AI is open only to ventures that are incorporated in Canada or are actively in the process of incorporating in Canada. NEXT AI is designed for ambitious founders who are prepared to fully engage, move quickly, act on feedback, and contribute meaningfully to a community of high-performing peers. We welcome founders from all backgrounds and believe diverse perspectives strengthen innovation and the responsible development of AI. Following our internal review, selected applicants will be invited to interviews taking place during the last week of January. For more information, visit https://www.nextcanada.com/next-ai/ or contact stephania@nextai.com for Toronto and infomtl@nextai.com for Montréal/Remote. Data privacy and ownership By completing this application form and applying to NEXT AI, you authorize NEXT Canada and HEC Montréal to collect your personal information. Your information will be used by us to contact you regarding your registration, as well as to assess your application to the program. Your information will not be shared with any third parties.
